name: ostrakon
description: Capture thoughts mid-work, triage them across projects and machines, and turn them into prompts

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Where notes are stored (default ~/.local/share/ostrakon). OSTRAKON_DIR overrides it.

pocket.title: Pocket
pocket.description: Show this project's open notes as numbered chips above the prompt (a digit in an empty prompt pulls one in). Off keeps only the ✎.

pocketMax.title: Pocket size
pocketMax.description: How many notes the band shows (1 to 9).

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.description: After each turn, ask the model once (from the cached conversation) for side issues worth keeping; they wait above the prompt for you to keep. Claude's own work is unchanged. Off: notes come only from you, or from Claude when you ask it to jot.

harvestMode.title: Harvest mode
harvestMode.description: fork: the review reads the whole cached conversation, so it also sees what Claude read in files and tool results (cost grows with the conversation). light: a small model reads only your prompt, Claude's final answer and the notes already saved (cheap, blind to tool results).

harvestMaxPerTurn.title: Harvest per turn
harvestMaxPerTurn.description: Most notes harvest proposes after one turn (1 to 9).

hubUrl.title: Hub URL
hubUrl.description: The ostrakon hub to sync with (server/hub.ts), e.g. https://<host>.<tailnet>.ts.net. Empty: no sync.

mirrorDir.title: Mirror folder
mirrorDir.description: Another folder to keep in step with the notes, for Dropbox, Syncthing or an Obsidian vault (e.g. ~/Dropbox/Ostrakon). Made if its parent exists. Empty: none.
